# Introduction {.unnumbered}

This is a website dedicated to the creation of morphological transducer for Tsova Tush during the [CauLaGe Zemo Alvani Field Research](https://zafier.gitpages.huma-num.fr/homepage/index.html) (ZAFieR) Station from August 18 to 27, 2026. Materials are based on [@wichersschreur2025] and [@kadagidze84].
